entries.state_summary: The authorized source-bound calibration tests whether Hodge-branch directions alone determine a useful chosen-witness reachable obstruction envelope B_{T,1}.
entries.action_summary: Contrast semiregular/complete-intersection positive controls with a hostile source where the Hodge locus moves while the originally selected algebraic witness family is rigid.
alternatives_considered: infer witness mobility directly from Hodge-locus mobility
retry full semiregularity as the general target
construct witness reachability explicitly before detector testing
entries.decision_rationale: The hostile control has maximum partition value because it directly tests whether class persistence and persistence of the chosen witness are the same research coordinate.
uncertainties: the source contrast does not by itself compute an obstruction group for every witness formalism
residuals: a source-defined witness-moduli projection is still needed to compute chosen-witness reachability
next_steps: record the source-bound calibration result without theorem authority

entries.state_summary: The calibration finds source-valid positive controls for Hodge-to-witness deformation but no certified proper nonzero branch-reachable envelope. A hostile source shows Hodge-class mobility can coexist with rigidity of the chosen witness family.
entries.action_summary: Record SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT_FOR_PROPER_ENVELOPE and isolate class persistence versus chosen-witness persistence as a representation/bridge distinction.
alternatives_considered: classify the hostile control as a Hodge-conjecture failure
treat the strong positive controls as a general theorem template
preserve the result as a scoped representation/gluing diagnosis
entries.decision_rationale: The sources distinguish the Hodge-class coordinate from identity and deformation of a selected algebraic witness; no source justifies collapsing them.
uncertainties: a different witness category may yield a proper nonzero reachable envelope
residuals: chosen witness category and projection to the Hodge branch are not yet frozen
next_steps: open a fresh witness-moduli projection representation child

entries.state_summary: The active residual is no longer detector faithfulness on an implicitly defined relevant subspace; it is construction of an explicit witness-moduli projection whose relative tangent/obstruction image can define reachability before success is observed.
entries.action_summary: Open H4d1a1-WITNESS-MODULI-PROJECTION as a fresh representation child and keep the new failure observation at OBSERVED_ONLY authority.
alternatives_considered: invent an all-order branch-restricted semiregularity theorem
refine representation around witness identity/projection first
entries.decision_rationale: The calibration reopens RELATION, PATH, OBSTRUCTION and EXPERIENCE_PATTERN axes; operator invention is not justified because existing contrastive/source-bound operators succeeded.
uncertainties: the appropriate witness category may differ across codimension and source family
residuals: freeze witness category and pi:W->S before the next discriminator
separate same-witness persistence from replacement by another representative of the same Hodge class
next_steps: compile a v3 problem fibre with explicit witness identity/interface keys
